  "memo":"R03 holds, making Card the sole adverse family. All other active rule conditions fail; no household exception is needed, and no earlier outcome settles the order. The applicable evidence row is §6.6(b), but the completed id_check failed, so §5.3(b) now requires decline without Linkage. Travel plausibly explains the geography, but cannot override the failed verification. Recommend declining the unshipped order and blocking the account under policy; no further check is needed.
